summary.en: The Detective Boys decide to go mushroom picking in the North-East mountains. Unfortunately, Genta gets lost in the hunting area while picking up mushrooms, and the Detective Boys have to split into two groups to search for Genta. But while searching of Genta, Haibara and Mitsuhiko encounter a dead body in the woods, and have become the targets of a dangerous hunter. Haibara found the dead hunter while Mitsuhiko tells the culprit that they're people. Once Genta is found, three hunters decide to help them by looking for Haibara and Mitsuhiko.
